en: Well, well! It's been a while, {player}. The Pokémon of these hills are restless today. They can smell danger on the wind, I think.
Danger in the shape of Team Plasma, no doubt. Tell me...
Do you plan to stand against Team Plasma?
I see. Then you'll need the strength to protect your Pokémon yourself. A Trainer who is only protected by Pokémon isn't really a Trainer.
It's because Trainers care for their Pokémon that their Pokémon can grow so strong. Here, take this.
I see! That's an answer too. You and your Pokémon can go your own way.
What matters is that you care for your Pokémon and draw out everything they have. Here, take this.
A prototype of a device of mine that energises Pokémon. It does nothing in battle, but you may find it useful elsewhere.
Come to think of it! In the Seaside Cave on Route 21 there's a great boulder that isn't quite a boulder. My machine might wake it up.
Well then. I wish you and your Pokémon a safe journey!
The Seaside Cave is on Route 21, south of Humilau. Good luck!
